title: Horizon Expansion
description: This mod adds many new sets of armor into the game, all with unique abilities, and with items that change how you play the game. Currently in development.
body:
Horizon Expansion
Horizon Expansion is a survival mod that adds new endgame challenges, complex bosses, and powerful gear to Minecraft.

Features
Custom Entities: Face off against three new mobs with advanced mechanics:
Kinetic Golem: A rolling mechanical boss that builds momentum to deal damage and reflects attacks with a kinetic shield.
Chrono Wraith: A clockwork entity that slows time, freezes projectiles, and teleports players into the past.
Eclipse Stalker: A wall-crawling shadow arachnid that plunges the area into darkness and teleports to your blind spot.
The Tesseract of Doom: An endgame item that generates an inescapable, multi-tiered labyrinth filled with trapped corridors, rare spawners, and loot vaults.
Weapons & Armor: Mine five new ores (Goliath, Kinetic, Chrono, Glacial, Eclipse) to craft heavy-stat armor sets, and wield an arsenal of endgame weapons like the Singularity Blade and Chaos Sword.
Utility Items: Includes survival tools like the Magnetic Ring, Escape Rope, Glow Chalk, and Portable Campfire.
Requires Forge. JEI is recommended for crafting recipes.
